<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { DrawerLabels } from "./cart-drawer.types";
  import type { CartLine, CartLabels } from "./cart-list.types";
  import type { SummaryRow } from "./order-summary.types";

  export type CartDrawerProps = {
    id: string;
    lines: CartLine[];
    rows: SummaryRow[];
    labels: CartLabels;
    drawer: DrawerLabels;
    state?: "filled" | "empty";
    media?: "image" | "none";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../primitives/block/block.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Container from "../primitives/container/container.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import DrawerLines from "../components/drawer-lines.svelte";

  let { id, lines, rows, labels, drawer, state = "filled", media = "image" }: CartDrawerProps = $props();
</script>

<Block tag="section" class="py-8" aria-label={drawer.title} data-testid="section">
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4" data-slot="container">
    <Box class="flex min-h-160 overflow-hidden rounded bg-muted inset-ring inset-ring-border">
      <Box class="hidden flex-1 flex-col gap-4 p-8 sm:flex" aria-hidden="true">
        <Box class="h-8 w-48 rounded bg-background" />
        <Box class="h-40 rounded bg-background" />
        <Box class="h-40 rounded bg-background" />

      <Block

        aria-label={drawer.title}
        data-testid="drawer"
      >
        <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="border-b border-border p-4">
          <Title as={2} size="lg" weight="semibold">
            {drawer.title}
          </Title>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" layout="icon" aria-label={drawer.close}>
            <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} />
          </Button>
        </Group>
        {#if ((state as string) === "empty")}
          <Stack gap="4" align="center" class="flex-1 justify-center p-8 text-center" data-testid="empty">
            <LucideIcon name="shopping-bag" size={32} />

            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {drawer.emptyText}
            </Text>
            <Button variant="outline" size="default">
              {drawer.browse}
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        {:else}
          <DrawerLines lines={lines} rows={rows} labels={labels} drawer={drawer} media={media} />
